Specification of State Management
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
7.7.5 StateMachine state changes
When a request to change a
StateMachine State
is issued by a
SMControlAp-
plication
there are more steps to consider:
[SWS_SM_00605] StateMachine service interface RequestTransition - recovery
ongoing
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00001, RS_SM_00005
⌈
The
RequestTransition
method shall return
kRecoveryTransitionOngoing
if internal flag is set that error recovery is ongoing (see [SWS_SM_00601]) and shall
cease any further processing of the request.
⌋
